title: From Graham to Buffett and Beyond
summary: The video argues that Apple's current valuation multiple has significant room to re-rate upward. This potential re-rating is based on the premise that Apple should be valued as a technology or consumer platform similar to Amazon, Google, Meta, Netflix, PayPal, or Uber. The core investment view is that the market is currently undervaluing Apple relative to these comparable tech giants.
